Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Documents required with Bid for Bid evaluation: Vendors are requested to submit Techno-commercial of fer along with endorsed "tender document, Nil deviation certificate, SPC". 5. Payment Terms: 100% payment within 30 days after receipt and acceptance of the material at NSPCL Si te Stores. 7. Delivery period and Schedule: Delivery to be completed preferably within 6 months from receipt of PO. However, the vendor must endeavour to supply material at the earliest. 8. Bid Evaluation Criteria: Bid Evaluation shall be done item wise. 9. Additional Requirement/ Information: a). Manufacturers Guarantee/Warranty period shall be 18/12 months from the date of supply/Use whichev er is earlier. b). Item Short text is indicative and should not be referred for quoting. Item Long description, mentioned b elow respective items is to be referred and considered for quoting and bid submission. c). If "Suffix" and "Cage Material" are not mentioned in bearing description, bearing clearance be consider ed as "Normal" & Cage material to be considered as Steel/Brass. Polyamide/Plastic cages in such cases will not be accepted. Equivalent Bearings are acceptable as per the long description of bearing. Bid participation criteria:

1. This bid is reserved for NTPC Source Standardized Vendors for Bearings or their authorized dealer. However, the authorization letter from the NSPCL Source Standardized Vendor should be te nder specific and they have to stand guarantee for the quality of supplied material ordered on thei r authorized dealer. Bids by vendors not meeting these criteria shall be rejected during technical e valuation. 2. In case of Award, authorized dealer has to supply material from NSPCL Source Standardized Vend or only, along with supporting documents. 3. Bidders having valid source standardization on the Date of Actual Bid Opening (BOD) for Material Group shall only be considered eligible for Technical evaluation 4. Dealer must upload the authorization letter along with the email sent to their parent compan y by the buyer dept. (as mentioned above) along with their bid for participation in the bid, failing which bid shall not be accepted.
